Facility build-out and lease deposits of $150-800k precede first revenue, breaching the capital gate. Demand is reachable and recurring and the format is commonly manager-run, but no Item 19 or pricing data was retrieved; ROIC is ~10-50% by the record's own math, with long-lease, zoning and incident-liability risk.

Instrumentl proves nonprofits pay for funding intelligence, but public agencies buy slowly with tiny budgets, and free sources (grants.gov, state portals, vendor-sponsored fire/EMS grant sites) already serve this. Federal grant volatility and AI search erode value. Record itself caps at $10k/mo.
